title: Character turnaround, then motion that stays on model
technique: reference image: a turnaround sheet keeps the character consistent

keyframes.prompt: Character turnaround sheet of a young street dancer: front, three-quarter, side and back views in one row, full body, neutral pose, identical outfit in every view: oversized orange windbreaker, black cargo pants, white high-top sneakers, silver headphones around the neck. Plain light grey background, no labels. 21:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: The dancer from @Image 1, same face and outfit, performs a confident hip-hop routine on a night city rooftop: a few groove steps, a spin, then freezes and points at the camera. Handheld camera circling slowly, neon signs behind. A punchy hip-hop beat with sneaker squeaks.
